title: "Library"

{{< include _includes/library_text.qmd >}}

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DT))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(readr))
data <- read_csv("data/library.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
section_index <- which(names(data) == "Section") - 1
medium_index <- which(names(data) == "Medium") - 1
url_index <- which(names(data) == "URL")

if (length(url_index) == 1) {
	data$URL <- ifelse(
		is.na(data$URL) | data$URL == "",
		"",
		sprintf(
			'<a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">%s</a>',
			data$URL,
			htmltools::htmlEscape(data$URL)
		)
	)
}

# Set widths per column (in px). Change these values as needed.
column_widths <- c(
	"Name" = 300,
	"URL" = 320,
	"Section" = 120,
	"Medium" = 120
)

column_defs <- lapply(names(column_widths), function(column_name) {
	list(
		width = paste0(column_widths[[column_name]], "px"),
		targets = which(names(data) == column_name) - 1
	)
})

DT::datatable(
	data,
	filter = "top",
	escape = if (length(url_index) == 1) which(names(data) != "URL") else TRUE,
	rownames = FALSE,
	options = list(
		pageLength = 10,
		scrollX = TRUE,
		autoWidth = FALSE,
		columnDefs = column_defs,
		initComplete = JS(sprintf(
			"function() {
				var api = this.api();
				var sectionIdx = %d;
				var mediumIdx = %d;
				var mobileQuery = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 767.98px)');
				var tableContainer = $(api.table().container());

				var sectionValues = [];
				api.column(sectionIdx).data().unique().sort().each(function(d) {
					if (d !== null && d !== undefined && d !== '') {
						sectionValues.push(d);
					}
				});

				var mediumValues = [];
				api.column(mediumIdx).data().unique().sort().each(function(d) {
					if (d !== null && d !== undefined && d !== '') {
						mediumValues.push(d);
					}
				});

				var mobileControls = $('<div class=\"library-mobile-controls\"></div>');
				var mobileSearch = $('<input type=\"search\" class=\"library-mobile-search\" placeholder=\"Search all columns\" aria-label=\"Search library\">')
					.on('input', function() {
						api.search($(this).val()).draw();
					});

				var mobileSectionSelect = $('<select class=\"library-mobile-section form-control\" aria-label=\"Filter by section\"><option value=\"\">All sections</option></select>')
					.on('change', function() {
						var val = $.fn.dataTable.util.escapeRegex($(this).val());
						api.column(sectionIdx).search(val ? '^' + val + '$' : '', true, false).draw();
					});

				var mobileMediumSelect = $('<select class=\"library-mobile-medium form-control\" aria-label=\"Filter by medium\"><option value=\"\">All mediums</option></select>')
					.on('change', function() {
						var val = $.fn.dataTable.util.escapeRegex($(this).val());
						api.column(mediumIdx).search(val ? '^' + val + '$' : '', true, false).draw();
					});

				for (var i = 0; i < sectionValues.length; i++) {
					mobileSectionSelect.append('<option value=\"' + sectionValues[i] + '\">' + sectionValues[i] + '</option>');
				}

				for (var m = 0; m < mediumValues.length; m++) {
					mobileMediumSelect.append('<option value=\"' + mediumValues[m] + '\">' + mediumValues[m] + '</option>');
				}

				mobileControls.append(mobileSearch, mobileSectionSelect, mobileMediumSelect);
				tableContainer.before(mobileControls);

				function applyMobileColumnVisibility() {
					var isMobile = mobileQuery.matches;

					if (sectionIdx >= 0) {
						api.column(sectionIdx).visible(!isMobile, false);
					}

					if (mediumIdx >= 0) {
						api.column(mediumIdx).visible(!isMobile, false);
					}

					mobileControls.toggle(isMobile);

					api.columns.adjust().draw(false);
				}

				applyMobileColumnVisibility();
				mobileQuery.addEventListener('change', applyMobileColumnVisibility);

				function ensureDesktopDropdownFilters() {
					var filterRows = tableContainer.find('.dataTables_scrollHead thead tr:last-child, .dataTables_scrollBody thead tr:last-child');
					if (!filterRows.length) {
						var headerRows = $(api.table().node()).find('thead tr');
						filterRows = headerRows.last();
					}

					if (!filterRows.length) {
						return;
					}

					var sectionSearch = api.column(sectionIdx).search().replace(/^\\^/, '').replace(/\\$$/, '');
					var mediumSearch = api.column(mediumIdx).search().replace(/^\\^/, '').replace(/\\$$/, '');

					filterRows.each(function() {
						var filterCells = $(this).find('th, td');
						var sectionCell = filterCells.eq(sectionIdx);
						var mediumCell = filterCells.eq(mediumIdx);

						if (sectionCell.length) {
							var sectionSelect = $('<select class=\"library-filter-section form-control\" style=\"width: 100%%;\"><option value=\"\">All</option></select>')
								.on('change', function() {
									var val = $.fn.dataTable.util.escapeRegex($(this).val());
									api.column(sectionIdx).search(val ? '^' + val + '$' : '', true, false).draw();
								});

							for (var j = 0; j < sectionValues.length; j++) {
								sectionSelect.append('<option value=\"' + sectionValues[j] + '\">' + sectionValues[j] + '</option>');
							}

							sectionSelect.val(sectionSearch);
							sectionCell.empty().append(sectionSelect);
						}

						if (mediumCell.length) {
							var mediumSelect = $('<select class=\"library-filter-medium form-control\" style=\"width: 100%%;\"><option value=\"\">All</option></select>')
								.on('change', function() {
									var val = $.fn.dataTable.util.escapeRegex($(this).val());
									api.column(mediumIdx).search(val ? '^' + val + '$' : '', true, false).draw();
								});

							for (var n = 0; n < mediumValues.length; n++) {
								mediumSelect.append('<option value=\"' + mediumValues[n] + '\">' + mediumValues[n] + '</option>');
							}

							mediumSelect.val(mediumSearch);
							mediumCell.empty().append(mediumSelect);
						}
					});
				}

				ensureDesktopDropdownFilters();
				api.on('draw.dt', ensureDesktopDropdownFilters);
			}",
			section_index,
			medium_index
		))
	)
)
```
